subject: Discrepancy on Nebula Analytics marketplace invoices — ledger consolidation + escrow trace
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 08:15:00 -0400
Subject: Discrepancy: Nebula Analytics AWS/GCP invoice delta and escrow hold

Team —

Quick heads-up: Nebula flagged a ~22% delta between the Marketplace invoice they received (AWS invoice #AW-98431) and the aggregated seller ledger we have for their account (see attached snapshot). They also say there’s a separate GCP charge that wasn’t showing up in their seller reconciliation, and they’re claiming our payout was withheld under escrow for an entity mismatch.

What I pulled so far: 
- Redwood ledger (attached): aggregator snapshot by marketplace SKU for 2026-07 (redwood_ledger_snapshot_20260812.csv).
- Nebula claims invoice AW-98431 + Nebula internal invoice AUG-2026 show an extra $47,892 that our ledger doesn’t map.
- Possible causes: duplicate metering rows from cross-account listing, or seller entity mapping (Nebula uses two legal entities in AWS + a separate GCP listing).

Ask: can Karthik and Marissa pair to produce a concise evidence bundle for Nebula and Marketplace containing: 
1) Per-sku usage roll-up (raw usage ids) for 2026-07 (AWS + GCP)
2) Any seller-entity mapping we applied during marketplace ingestion (tenant ids/marketplace ids)
3) Timestamps for when the escrow hold was applied and the routing key used

I’m going to loop in Nebula once we have a clear mapping and a proposed correction (refund or ledger adjustment). Please include the path for VAT/tax remittance impact in the bundle — Nebula is in the US but their reseller chain passes through an EU entity.

Attachments: redwood_ledger_snapshot_20260812.csv

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Marketplace Finance
Redwood Inference
---

From: Evan Chen <evan@nebula-analytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: AWS Marketplace <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 11:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discrepancy: Nebula Analytics AWS/GCP invoice delta and escrow hold

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the quick note. I’ve attached Nebula’s invoice and our internal reconciliation that shows the $47,892 difference (nebula_invoice_AUG2026.pdf). A few clarifications from our side: 
- The GCP charges are for a separate project (nebula-data-ekg) that we onboarded in July; we pushed inventory under the same public listing but a different billing entity.
- We were notified of an escrow hold on 2026-07-30 (screenshot included in the PDF) with reason code "ENTITY_MISMATCH". That hold caused our downstream accounting to block payout while we gathered evidence.

We can share signed statements and a short CSV of our seller-side usage ids if Redwood needs them. For VAT: our EU reseller (Nebula EU SARL) handled VAT on their end; if Redwood moves funds between entities, we need a clear remittance trail to avoid duplicate VAT exposure.

Can your team confirm whether the missing rows were dropped on ingestion or routed to the wrong seller_id? If you want, I can schedule a quick screen-share tomorrow (Aug 14) 09:00–12:00 PT.

Attachments: nebula_invoice_AUG2026.pdf

Best,
Evan Chen
Head of Finance, Nebula Analytics
evan@nebula-analytics.com

Subject: Re: Discrepancy: Nebula Analytics AWS/GCP invoice delta and escrow hold

Evan / AWS team / Marissa / Karthik —

Thanks for the context, Evan. We dug into ingestion logs and the short version is: several GCP usage rows arrived with an alternate seller_id (nebula_gcp_01) and were indexed under a separate marketplace tenant during the 2026-07 ingest cutover. That tenant was later merged into the primary Nebula record but the merge did not retroactively reassign the original usage id lines in our seller ledger export (hence the delta).

Proposed remediation and next steps: 
- Immediate ledger correction: we will prepare a retroactive allocation batch to move the affected usage rows into Nebula's primary seller_id and issue a corrected payout statement by Aug 20. Expect a net payout adjustment of $47,892 gross (we will compute VAT pass-through separately).
- Escrow hold: we will release the escrow on AWS once AWS confirms the entity mapping change (AWS team — can you confirm the hold removal process & ETA?).
- VAT remittance: Marissa, please prepare a short note on whether the correction creates a VAT refund liability for Redwood or requires Nebula to issue a credit note to their EU reseller. Include required docs for our tax team.
- Evidence bundle (shared): I uploaded a short packet to Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD-example-ledger-pack (includes redwood roll-up, raw usage ids, and a proposed allocation csv). HubSpot ticket HS-43219 is tracking this for collections.

Evan — can you confirm you’ll provide the signed seller-side usage CSV and the legal entity declaration for Nebula EU SARL by Tue Aug 17 EOD? That will let our tax team close the VAT question.

Attachments (we’ll send): gcp_usage_export_202607.zip (raw usage ids + timestamps)

Appreciate the fast turnaround here.

Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Marketplace Finance
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192
